name: agent-device-hub
description: Shared hub architecture and development workflow bootstrap

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/mcp/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/lifecycle-contracts/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/agent-state/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/hub/tsconfig.json && npm run build:dashboard
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/mcp/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/lifecycle-contracts/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/agent-state/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/hub/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck:dashboard
scripts.test:contracts: npm run build && npm run test:contracts:built
scripts.test:package: npm run build && npm run test:package:built
scripts.test:mcp: npm run build && npm run test:mcp:built
scripts.test:mcp:protocol: npm run build && npm run test:mcp:protocol:built
scripts.test:mcp:package: npm run build && npm run test:mcp:package:built
scripts.test:lifecycle: npm run build && npm run test:lifecycle:built
scripts.test:lifecycle:package: npm run build && npm run test:lifecycle:package:built
scripts.test:agent-state: npm run build && npm run test:agent-state:built
scripts.test:agent-state:package: npm run build && npm run test:agent-state:package:built
scripts.test:hub: npm run build && npm run test:hub:built
scripts.test:hub:package: npm run build && npm run test:hub:package:built
scripts.test:setup: npm run build && npm run test:setup:built
scripts.test:hub:mcp: npm run build && npm run test:hub:mcp:built
